description: Defines the ClaimAttachmentModel class, which serializes claim attachment data within the OrangeHRM system, including associated metadata and relations to user information.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentModel
classes.description: A model that represents the claim attachment data structure for API serialization, including attachment details and metadata about the user who attached it.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ClaimAttachmentModel with a PartialClaimAttachment entity and sets serialization filters and attribute mappings.
